AFE_3V0.basis: ADS131M04 IAVDD max 4.0 mA (high-resolution, SBAS890D rev D, 6.5 Electrical Characteristics) + 12 x TLV9064 IQ max 0.80 mA (-40..125 C, SBOS839, VS = 5.5 V; at 3.0 V it is lower) + 0.2 mA bias/divider/leakage allowance

DVDD_F.basis: X1 SX3M8.192M20F30TNN Icc <= 10 mA (15 pF, vendor sheet) + ADS131M04 IDVDD max 0.5 mA (SPI idle) + 0.5 mA SPI activity + 0.4 mA pull-ups (3.6 V / 10 k)

/XIAO_Brain_Interface/XIAO_3V3.basis: DVDD_F bound (the 3V3 pin feeds FB1 only on this board)

/Analog_Power_Interlock/VBAT_AFE.basis: AFE_3V0 bound + TPS7A2030 ground current (<= 1 mA allowance)

VBAT.basis: system bound, not a datasheet value: XIAO ESP32-S3 radio TX peak ~355 mA + charger/board margin -> 0.5 A; measure

/XIAO_5V.basis: USB-presence sense / inhibit network only on this board (the charge current is inside the module); 20 mA allowance
